title: WO recovery history waits for full proof and resumes the accepted host job
steps: Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to a disposable PostgreSQL database and run run.cmd.
Verify every case executes with zero failures and zero skips.
expect: Two bounded pending backup-history reads and a successful third owner read create only one host history job.
A stranger cannot resume or read the owner history job.
Only FLEET_JOB_PENDING is retried, with at most four reads within three minutes and run cancellation honored.
Writes invalidate pending sharing; an old response cannot remove the newer job identity.
Files-only backups, missing proof, failed reads and open native writers retain existing refusal rules.
An in-flight timeout after legitimate pending history retains SITE_RECOVERY_POINT_PENDING only at the overall deadline; external cancellation and network failure retain their original reasons.
